name: master-of
description: Skill-gate system for Claude Code: keeps rarely-used skills dormant behind domain gates (design/dev/pipelines/planning/research/stock, extensible) and activates only what a task actually needs, instead of loading every installed skill into every session. check-skills shows brief status + a health check (dead MCP servers, gated skills whose plugin is off); check-skills-all shows the full inventory.
